request: PLAN-2 E1: lines of the ten rooms' second screens (next_*, guide_* continued, open_<room>_2)

asr.tool: art/asr_check.py (faster-whisper small); mixed lines: zh pass for Chinese, zh+en passes for English words
notes: Every DIFF was read: homophones of whisper small (浮冰/伏兵, 河上/和尚, 往上/网上, 弹/谈), English words written as their Chinese translation in the zh pass (flower -> 花花, down -> 下), and the words this voice is already known to lose to the recogniser (up, high, ball, home; see anna-elevenlabs-voice-report.json). No clip reads a wrong sentence.
The DIFF rate (25 of 84 mixed segments) matches the accepted Lulu run (61 of 239).
